candidate_readme:
# Agent Trace

Exports each agent run as an OpenTelemetry trace so evals and local debugging can see timings, nesting, and token accounting without changing pi core.

## Load

```bash
pi -e packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/agent-trace
```

Or copy the `agent-trace/` directory into `~/.pi/agent/extensions/` or `.pi/extensions/` so `DefaultResourceLoader` discovers `index.ts`.

## Trace file

Spans are appended as JSON Lines to:

```text
<SessionManager.getSessionDir()>/traces/<session id>.otlp.jsonl
```

Set `PI_AGENT_TRACE_FILE` to write somewhere else. Each line is one OTLP/JSON `ExportTraceServiceRequest` with a single span. Finished spans are appended once and never rewritten, so `/reload` and a later process resuming the session add to the same file. Unfinished spans are not written.

Resource attributes: `service.name=pi`, `service.version` (coding-agent package version), `pi.session.id`, `process.pid`. Scope: `pi.agent-trace` version `1`. The session `traceId` is derived from the session id and is stable across reloads.

## Spans

| name | kind | parent | starts / ends | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `pi.run` | INTERNAL | none | `agent_start` / `agent_end` | `pi.run.trigger` is `prompt`, `continuation`, or `wakeup`. `pi.session.entry_id` is the user message (prompt) or the custom message that started the run (wakeup/continuation). |
| `pi.turn` | INTERNAL | run | `turn_start` / `turn_end` | Index, stop reason, tool call count. Error if the assistant `stopReason` is `error` or `aborted`. |
| `chat <model>` | CLIENT | turn | assistant `message_start` / `message_end` | Provider, model, token usage, finish reason, assistant entry id. |
| `execute_tool <tool name>` | INTERNAL | turn | `tool_execution_start` / `tool_execution_end` | Tool name, call id, `pi.tool.is_error`, tool-result entry id. Error when the tool result is an error. |
| `pi.compaction` | INTERNAL | none | `session_before_compact` / `session_compact` or `session_compact_failed` | Reason, retry flag, tokens before and compaction entry id on success. |

A run whose turns failed is still OK. Compaction happens between runs, never inside one.
